integrity: The formula, structural bijection, and limit of the deterministic finite checks are explicitly distinguished. No independent examination is claimed.
limitations: The family is restricted to labeled rectangular rook graphs with both dimensions at least two. The matrix-tree and exponential-formula tools are standard. Unindexed earlier equivalent specializations remain possible; finite checks do not replace the general proof.
title: Connected-domination and minimal-set spectrum of rectangular rook graphs
